## Proposal blockers

1. **Architecture and model change together (method-fit test).** Experimental Setup: each architecture runs on a different model, so RQ1's architecture effect cannot be separated from a model effect. Suggestion: run every configuration on both models.

## Clarify early in the thesis

1. **Pilot size.** The pilot that decides whether the failure set is subsampled has no stated size.
   - What needs deciding: how many failures the pilot runs.
   - Why it matters: the subsampling decision rests on it.
   - When: before the first full benchmark run.
   - Reasonable resolution: one failure per category.
   - Revisit the proposal on an adverse outcome: no.
